paragraphs.text: Chapter 3 The Witch The Little Mermaid went to look
She swam to a very dark place.
She thought, This is a very scary place, but I must go.
A whirlpool could suck her into its middle.
After some time, she saw the witch's house.
It was made from many dead sailors bones.
The sea princess felt very afraid.
Then she thought, The prince and my soul.
She even saw a young mermaid lying dead.
This shocked the little mermaid very much.
Again, the little mermaid wanted to leave.
But, the witch came out of the door and said, Don't go.
The little mermaid followed the witch into the bone house.
Your family will be very sad.
But, I will give you your wish.
I will give you something to drink.
You must take it with you.
Tomorrow morning, before sunrise, you must swim to land.
But, it will be very painful.
It will be like knives in your legs and feet.
The mermaid said to the witch, I can do it.
The witch looked at her carefully.
You can never become a mermaid again.
You can never swim with your sisters.
You can never see your father or grandmother again.
Then, you can have a soul.
But, you will die when he marries another girl.
The little mermaid said, Yes, I will do it.
The prince will love your beauty.
The witch started to make the medicine.
She used many awful things in the medicine.
She put in a fish stomach.
Then, she put in crab eyes.
Next, she put in squid brains.
She said, You must give me your tongue.
The princess stuck out her tongue.
She tried to speak, but could not make any words.
The witch spoke to her again.
Tomorrow morning, before sunrise, do as I said.
The princess wanted to say, I will do that.
So, she only nodded her head.
And, she left the witch's house.
She wanted to go and speak to her sisters.
But, she could not say one word.
Instead, she went to the flower gardens.
She took flowers from her sister's gardens.
She wanted a memory of her sisters and her home.
The sea princess swam through the water.
She swam close to the princess palace.
It was like a knife in her body.
She fell down in the sand.
